prompt:
Rewrite this TypeScript to use optional chaining and nullish coalescing, changing nothing else:

const name = user && user.profile && user.profile.name ? user.profile.name : 'anon';
why: There is exactly one idiomatic rewrite: user?.profile?.name ?? 'anon'.

prompt: Write a shell one-liner that prints the machine's unified memory in whole GB on macOS. Output only the command.
why: sysctl -n hw.memsize divided by 1073741824 is the standard way; this is the exact line used in this dotfiles repo's rebuild.sh.

prompt: Convert this to a single git command: show me the names of files changed in the last commit, nothing else.
why: git show --name-only --pretty=format: HEAD (or git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD) are the accepted answers.
